notes: Ours (Filtered/Evolving Rubric + Effectiveness + Outcome, R_t = 0.4 R_O + 0.3 R_A,t + 0.3 R_E,t) with the corrected implementation of the causal validation's intervention. Nothing else differs from ours.json: same failures, candidates, 3 reruns, keep at 2, weights, diagnosis-equivalence mapping.

intervention.notes: The response of the failed turn is written by the iteration's Agent under the candidate's ideal behavior; the run's rubric scorer (Jev), which wrote neither the candidate nor the response, scores it against the candidate rubric. The first of at most 3 attempts at score 2 is frozen and is the failed turn of all reruns as it is; only what follows is generated. No score-2 attempt: intervention_generation_failure, the candidate is not rerun and counts neither as pass nor as fail.
